create_GithubPath_from_repo: create a GithubPath object from a repository name and branch for navigating GitHub files
query_GithubApi_tree: query the GitHub API to retrieve the full recursive tree of a repository branch
read_GithubPath_file: read the content of a file from a GitHub repository using a GithubPath object
copy_GithubPath_file: copy a file from a GitHub repository to a local or cloud destination path
parse_github_path: parse a github:// URL string into repository, branch, and subpath components
